source_quote.quote: diffuse astrocytic glioma, IDH-wildtype, with molecular features of glioblastoma
Tumor O-6-methylguanine-deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) methyltransferase (MGMT) methylation status must be available from any prior GBM tumor specimen

coder_notes: Registered interventions are a device (GammaTile, Cs-131) and radiation only; bevacizumab or lomustine appear only as the adjuvant systemic therapy every patient receives in both arms, so they are listed as soc_backbone. MGMT: only availability of status is required, not a particular status. EGFR amplification/chr7 gain/chr10 loss/TERT are alternative diagnostic criteria for IDH-wildtype GBM and not coded as biomarkers. Registry phase is PHASE4.
